changeSet.author: techdocs
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE normative_sourcebooks ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(64), original_filename VARCHAR(500), storage_path VARCHAR(1000), page_count INT, rate_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UPLOADED', error_message TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );

changeSet.author: techdocs
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE normative_rates ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, sourcebook_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES normative_sourcebooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, unit VARCHAR(128), work_composition TEXT, labor_cost NUMERIC(14,2), -- ЗП, руб machine_cost NUMERIC(14,2), -- ЭМ всего, руб machine_labor NUMERIC(14,2), -- в т.ч. ЗПМ, руб material_cost NUMERIC(14,2), -- МР, руб labor_hours NUMERIC(12,3), -- затраты труда, чел-ч page_number INT ); CREATE INDEX idx_rates_sourcebook ON normative_rates(sourcebook_id); CREATE INDEX idx_rates_code ON normative_rates(code); ALTER TABLE normative_rates ADD COLUMN search_tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('russian', coalesce(name,'') || ' ' || coalesce(code,'') || ' ' || coalesce(work_composition,''))) STORED; CREATE INDEX idx_rates_tsv ON normative_rates USING GIN (search_tsv);
